checks: The 35-site census and closed 19-site cap census were independently enumerated. The upper corner of the rectangle gives 1−A−B>0 and hence positive fiber volumes. The spanning base offsets make the Hessian positive definite.

Direct multinomial expansion of the weighted moments and the total and cap masses reproduced every cubic coefficient. Differentiating the moment polynomials gives the same mixed partial on both sides.

Independent interval bounds confirmed the negative mixed partial bound −1514823/62500 and all four rational corner values. Their signs and the negative mixed partial force a decreasing inward coordinate direction on every boundary side of the compact rectangle.

Zero gradient cancels the x and y base moments, and the finite z-layer mean cancels the third. The identity Σh⁴=Σh³ gives the ordinary simplex centroid as the continuous mean, so the point is actual at the central base.

Independent exact signed monomial bounds reproduced 8681336352206248242879/4000000000000000000000000 as a positive uniform gap. The factorial-series remainder gives e<68/25<1000/367. Source dc03bcfaffa32184 §3 has the same parameters, cap and conclusion.

overlap.comparison: Its general centroid obstruction uses a continuous cut and does not prove failure of a dimension-free vertical one-sided centroid bound in a fixed three-base-coordinate family.

review_method: Independent mathematical proof review of the frozen normalized candidate
summary: The rational rectangle certifies an interior polynomial minimizer with zero base moments. Its true mixed centroid is captured by a vertical cap below 367/1000.
